cases.name: case_a_horizontal_only_regression
cases.description: Fresh target_point is present, but the target never enters the horizontal alignment gate.

cases.name: case_b_vertical_entry
cases.description: Stable centered target enables vertical gate and enters HORIZONTAL_AND_VERTICAL.

cases.name: case_c_z_stale
cases.description: target_point becomes stale after vertical is enabled; horizontal remains fresh.

cases.name: case_d_vertical_stay
cases.description: Target remains aligned with fresh target_point for several ticks after vertical entry.

cases.name: case_e_vertical_exit_to_horizontal
cases.description: After vertical entry, horizontal alignment is broken but tracking continuity remains valid.

cases.name: case_f_target_distance_threshold_hook
cases.description: z_meas crosses the hold-zero distance threshold.

cases.name: case_g_target_point_stale_dvl_fallback
cases.description: target_point becomes stale but fresh DVL altitude keeps vertical allowed.

cases.name: case_h_target_point_recovers_after_fallback
cases.description: After one DVL fallback tick, fresh target_point returns and becomes primary again.

cases.name: case_i_v_axis_over_150_vertical_off
cases.description: After vertical entry, v alone exceeds 150 px and immediately gates off z.

cases.name: case_j_u_axis_over_150_vertical_off
cases.description: After vertical entry, u alone exceeds 150 px and immediately gates off z.
